note: Short paraphrases of the DIRECTION and Shaping decisions the question-gate-v1 gate cites (evidence/jev-routing-calibration/calibrate_gate_v3.py SETTLED, README.md). The plan folder is outside this repository, so these paraphrases are copied here; the audit adds the package's own `## Settled` entries at run time.

entries.text: Hooks, tools and logging move to Rust eventually; starting Elixir in hooks is too slow.
Live (paid) checks are chosen deliberately, never by default, and an edited live test always runs in the same Intent.
Plans live in the iCloud Kogen plan folder, not in .kogen/runtime/shaping-followups.
Plain Kogen always requires explicit human approval of each Intent; only Kogen Studio may approve on the human's behalf.
Use slugs, not numeric ids, to refer to Intents.
Never add plumbing (function, config key, role, option) whose caller comes in a later Intent; wire it in the same Intent.
Never split or defer requested scope to another Intent on the agent's own judgement, and never to avoid paid checks; a necessary split is the human's decision.
The Shaping auditor runs on the adversarial harness on hybrid routes; on Codex it is GPT-6 Sol at high effort, on Claude it is Opus at high effort.
The Shaping audit reshapes automatically and waits for the human only on UI/UX/product decisions.
